items.title: US ransomware negotiators get 4 years in prison over BlackCat attacks
items.description: Two former employees of cybersecurity incident response companies Sygnia and DigitalMint were sentenced to four years in prison each for targeting U.S. companies in BlackCat (ALPHV) ransomware attacks. [...]

items.title: New Fake CAPTCHA Campaign Uses SMS Pumping Fraud to Run Up Victims’ Phone Bills
items.description: A newly documented scam campaign is using fake CAPTCHA pages to silently trigger dozens of international SMS messages from victims’ mobile phones, leaving them with unexpected charges on their phone bills. items.title: 1,800 Hit in Mini Shai-Hulud Attack on SAP, Lightning, Intercom
items.description: The compromised Lightning and Intercom packages have a combined monthly download count of nearly 10 million. The post 1,800 Hit in Mini Shai-Hulud Attack on SAP, Lightning, Intercom appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Critical Wireshark Vulnerabilities Let Attackers Execute Arbitrary Code Via Malformed Packets
items.description: Wireshark, the world’s most widely used open-source network protocol analyzer, has released a major security update addressing over 40 vulnerabilities, several of which enable arbitrary code execution through malformed packet injection or malicious capture files. Organizations and individuals relying on Wireshark for network monitoring, forensics, and traffic analysis should update immediately…
